conflicts.subject: suggestion-input
conflicts.detail: B's suggest() takes one free-text string; A's Ticket has no text field (only status and a thread of agent replies), so it is undecided which ticket text the FAQ matcher reads
solutions: Match on the ticket's subject and description, set when it is created
Match on the latest message only
conflicts.recommended: Match on subject and description: they are the customer's question; agent replies would make the agent's own words pull in FAQs

resolution.decision: The FAQ matcher reads the ticket's subject and description only; replies are not matched.
resolution.note: medium; pre-approved by the benchmark operator with Claude's recommendation

conflicts.subject: backend-runtime
conflicts.detail: Several runtimes: node: A; python: B
solutions: Choose one backend runtime and rebuild the features from the other
Keep two services only if a kept feature truly needs the other runtime
conflicts.recommended: One backend runtime for the unified app, chosen in the architecture phase

resolution.decision: One backend runtime: Python 3 (standard library). B is the user's own Python code and may be adapted; A's JavaScript may not be reused (no licence file) and is rebuilt anyway.
resolution.note: medium; pre-approved by the benchmark operator with Claude's recommendation
